claims.subject: canonical-name
claims.statement: Canonical profile name is Rocke.
claims.verification_rationale: The canonical name is mapped to a MITRE ATT&CK group ID.

claims.subject: fixed-public-datasets
claims.statement: Rocke was cross-checked against all fixed public datasets; result=matched.
claims.verification_rationale: Matched datasets: etda-threat-group-cards, misp-mitre-intrusion-set, misp-threat-actor. Exact normalized-name matching and aggregation aliases do not prove one-to-one vendor cluster identity. A no-match result records completed searches, not actor nonexistence.

claims.subject: irongroup
claims.statement: Iron Group is associated with Rocke with scope overlapping.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=knowledge-base; vendor scope must be preserved.

claims.subject: countries
claims.statement: Attributed country or countries: China.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=repository. Community workbook-only attribution requires independent corroboration.

claims.subject: malware--xbash
claims.statement: Rocke uses or has used XBash.
claims.verification_rationale: Evidence tier=repository.
